facts.fact: The Digital Code provides in articles 262 to 270 for creating the Autorité de protection des données, which the source says has not yet been set up; the source's date is 2025 and no event date is given.
A ministerial order of 17 August 2024 gave the authority's missions to the ARPTIC, and a Prime Minister's decree is still to fix its organisation and operation.
